title: Beds Don't Explode
description: A simple mod that makes it so a bed will not explode upon use when in other dimensions.
body:
For those who either think that beds used as explosives are too overpowered or that it simply makes no sense.

Now, instead of exploding, a simple message will display, just like if you tried to sleep during the day, stating "You can't sleep here.".

![Trying to sleep in the nether](https://i.imgur.com/GyIQCV3.png)
